deskRsRunningTitle: Searching the chain for this wallet's funds

@deskRsRunningTitle.description: Overview and Settings > Recheck balance: title of the panel while the scan a restore needs runs, before it reports a percentage.

deskRsRunningPercent: Searching the chain for this wallet's funds · {percent} %

@deskRsRunningPercent.description: Overview and Settings > Recheck balance: title of the panel while the scan a restore needs runs, with how far it is.

deskRsRunningText: Receiving and sending open when the scan ends. The wallet can stay open meanwhile.

@deskRsRunningText.description: Overview: small text under the restore scan's progress bar.

deskRsRunningFromHeight: From the start height first, then from block 0. Receiving and sending open when both end.

@deskRsRunningFromHeight.description: Overview: small text under the progress bar while a restore that was given a start height scans from it; the scan from block 0 follows by itself.

deskRsWaitingTitle: The restore scan waits for the network

@deskRsWaitingTitle.description: Overview: notice title when a restored wallet's scan cannot run because the app is Offline.

deskRsWaitingText: It starts when Offline is turned off. Until then the balance shows what is on this computer.

@deskRsWaitingText.description: Overview: notice text when a restored wallet's scan waits for Offline to end.

deskRsFailedTitle: The restore scan did not finish

@deskRsFailedTitle.description: Overview: notice title when the scan a restore needs stopped with an error; also the toast title when Try again fails.

deskRsFailedText: Receiving and sending wait for it. It also starts again with the next block.

@deskRsFailedText.description: Overview: notice text when the restore scan stopped with an error.

@deskRsTryAgain.description: Overview: button in the notice when the restore scan stopped; runs it again.

deskRsSendWaits: Sending opens when the restore scan ends.

@deskRsSendWaits.description: Small text under the buttons on Overview while Send is disabled until the restore scan ends.

deskRsRecheckWaits: Recheck balance can start when the restore scan has ended.

@deskRsRecheckWaits.description: Settings > Recheck balance: small text under the disabled Start button while the restore scan runs.

@deskSetRescanFrom.description: Settings > Recheck balance: label of the choice where the scan starts (Advanced > Recheck from a height).

@deskSetRescanFromRecent.description: Settings > Recheck balance: choice that scans from a little before the last scan's end (the default).

deskErrRestoreScanRequired: The restore scan has not finished yet. Receiving and sending open when it ends.

@deskErrRestoreScanRequired.description: Error when the wallet refuses to receive or send because the scan a restore needs has not finished.
